description: This file defines the HasPermissionCondition class, which implements a conditional check for user permissions within the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It processes the <if-has-permission> XML element, evaluates user permissions, and executes associated sub-operations based on the condition.

classes.name: HasPermissionCondition
classes.description: Implements a permission check condition for the MiniLang framework, evaluating user permissions and executing sub-operations accordingly.

classes.name: HasPermissionConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of HasPermissionCondition based on XML elements.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current user has the specified permission and action.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on the permission check result.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Generates a human-readable representation of the permission condition.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <if-has-permission> element.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Factory method to create a HasPermissionCondition instance from an XML element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a MethodOperation instance, specifically a HasPermissionCondition, from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the condition element, 'if-has-permission'.
